title: The Household Animal
sentences: The domestic pet occupies a category that our ordinary language handles rather badly.
It is neither property in any usual sense of that word nor a full member of the household.
The law treats it as the former while families behave as though it were plainly the latter.
The contradiction tends to surface at exactly the moments that matter most to everyone.
Decisions about a sick animal are made by someone that animal cannot possibly argue with.
We describe those decisions in the vocabulary of mercy, and we do mean it sincerely.
Sincerity does not resolve the very real asymmetry of power that the situation involves.
What makes the relationship valuable is partly the same thing that makes it uneasy.
An animal accepts our company without ever having been in any position to consent to it.
Very little affection between adults is ever offered on anything remotely like those terms.
